thread:
emily_sales: Hi team — Orion Health emailed asking for SOC 2 executive summary, ISO27001 cert copy, a pen-test attestation letter scoped to the POC, a control-mapping to their security questionnaire, and confirmation we can run an isolated on-prem POC (temporary peering). They also want a cost comparison Dedicated vs Private for a 2-week trial and whether we can accelerate application of trial credits. They need something in 5 business days. Who can own this?

rowan_solutions: Ill take point on the evidence bundle. I can export a SOC2 exec summary + control mapping CSV. ISO cert is public, will link. For the pen-test attestation we use a standard template but security needs the PoC scope (assets, IP ranges, duration) before signing. Expect ~2-4 business days after scope is approved.

matt_security: Security checklist to provide the attestation: PoC scope (IP ranges, ASN if applicable), duration, allowed test types (no destructive testing w/out approval), data classification for PoC, and whether they expect a red-team or just vuln scan. We can issue an attestation letter but cannot attach raw vuln reports. If procurement needs a placeholder we can generate a "provisional attestation" with expected sign date once scope is received. Also: NDA required for detailed infra diagrams.

legal_ops: We can produce a provisional letter for procurement. Once NDA and DPA are signed we can share redacted network diagrams and SOW for private on-prem setup.

olivia_gts: Pricing (ballpark): Dedicated POC (2 weeks) ~ $500/day for reserved capacity (~$7,000 total). Private on-prem short POC: $3,500 mobilization + ~$600/day ops (~$8,900 total for 2 weeks incl mobilization). We can offer a one-time trial credit up to 40% if they convert to paid terms within 14 days. Ill put exact calc in a PDF quote and DM procurement.

emily_sales: Can finance apply the credit within the invoice cycle? They want to avoid billing lag.

olivia_gts: We can issue a credit voucher that posts within ~10 business days after acceptance; requires finance sign-off. Not instant, but faster than a full invoice adjustment.

infra-oncall: On the networking side we can provision temporary VPC peering / private connector in ~4800h after we have CIDR, NOC contact, and service ticket. Example CLI we use for staging peering:
```
redwood net peering create --customer-cidr 172.31.0.0/16 --env staging --owner emily_sales@redwood
```
For an on-prem isolated POC werell need a runbook, maintenance window, and operational contact. Recommend scheduling a 30m network call.

deploy-bot: Ephemeral creds created for thread owner: id=ephemeral-orion-789, expires_in=72h (staging). Secrets uploaded to secure vault.

matt_security: If they request KMS/HSM integration details for legal, we can share key rotation policy, supported algorithms, and a redacted example of tenant key metadata. We will redact ARNs and customer identifiers. Note: processing PHI requires a signed DPA.

rowan_solutions: Ill assemble the SOC2 summary, control mapping CSV, ISO cert link, and the pen-test attestation template. Ill ask security for the provisional attestation if they need something for procurement immediately. Ill also request PoC scope + NOC details from the customer in the outreach.

emily_sales: Thanks everyone. Il message Orion to clarify whether they truly need on-prem isolation or if VPC peering is enough and ask them to extend to 10 business days for full on-prem + attestation path. If they only need peering and docs we should be fine in 5 days. :thumbsup:
